title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 368 (Vesting of property on registration)

content.overview: All property, movable and immovable (including actionable claims), belonging to or vested in a company at the date of its registration in pursuance of this Part shall, on such registration, pass to and vest in the company as incorporated under this Act for all the estate and interest of the company therein.
content.glance: On registration under Part I of Chapter XXI, all property of the entity vests in the company as incorporated under the Act.
